correctness.rationale: For every upward-closed suffix U_j, row intersection is equivalent to M_t>=j and row inclusion to m_t>=j, with M_t=-1,m_t=n for empty rows. Forward/backward recurrences characterize each admissible row endpoint pair; independent free interior bits give its weight 2^{max(M-m-1,0)}, so multiplication proves every fiber. Directly and independently enumerated all 2^{n^2} raw binary relations at n=1,2,3,4; direct four-modal suffix truth tables give class counts 2,16,279,7171 matching endpoint-record partition; all-row-extreme construction proves n>=3 shared fibers.
